issue.title: Enhancement: ASIC thermal sensors should be available via PDDF

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

In PDDF there is support for many types of thermal sensors. We need to be able to monitor the ASIC temperature sensors on the device and doing it through PDDF gives the best reusability.

### Current Behavior

ASIC Sensors are not monitored on PDDF platforms

### Proposed Behavior

We will use the ASIC Thermal Monitoring support described in the [https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/asic_thermal_monitoring_hld.md](ASIC Thermal Monitoring HLD) to add support for monitoring ASIC temperatures through PDDF.
